mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE visible_scope (organization_unit_id, include_descendants) AS ( SELECT scope_target_id, include_descendants FROM seal.user_scope WHERE admin_user_id = #{actorId} AND scope_type = 'ORGANIZATION' AND active = TRUE UNION SELECT child.organization_unit_id, TRUE FROM seal.organization_unit child JOIN visible_scope parent_scope ON child.parent_id = parent_scope.organization_unit_id WHERE parent_scope.include_descendants = TRUE )

recipient.recipient_id, recipient.organization_unit_id, recipient.recipient_name_ciphertext, recipient.recipient_email_ciphertext, recipient.encryption_key_id, recipient.email_lookup_hmac, recipient.collection_basis, recipient.recipient_status, recipient.version_no
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM visible_scope scope JOIN seal.organization_unit organization ON organization.organization_unit_id = scope.organization_unit_id WHERE organization.organization_unit_id = #{organizationId} AND organization.active = TRUE )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seal.recipient (recipient_id, organization_unit_id, recipient_name_ciphertext, recipient_email_ciphertext, encryption_key_id, email_lookup_hmac, collection_source, collection_basis, recipient_status, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, version_no) VALUES (#{record.recipientId}, #{record.organizationUnitId}, #{record.nameCiphertext}, #{record.emailCiphertext}, #{record.encryptionKeyId}, #{record.emailLookupHmac}, 'MANUAL', #{record.collectionBasis}, #{record.status}, #{actorId}, #{now}, #{actorId}, #{now}, #{record.versionNo})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM seal.recipient recipient JOIN visible_scope scope ON scope.organization_unit_id = recipient.organization_unit_id WHERE recipient.recipient_id = #{recipientId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE seal.recipient SET recipient_name_ciphertext = #{record.nameCiphertext}, recipient_email_ciphertext = #{record.emailCiphertext}, encryption_key_id = #{record.encryptionKeyId}, email_lookup_hmac = #{record.emailLookupHmac}, collection_basis = #{record.collectionBasis}, recipient_status = #{record.status}, updated_by = #{actorId}, updated_at = #{now}, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE recipient_id = #{record.recipientId} AND version_no = #{expectedVersion}
